release.goal: Deliver a recoverable offline release after the owner signs the restore checklist.
release.concept: Recoverable means the archive restores both records and per-project runtime state.
release.old_concept: Recoverable means a copy of the database exists.
release.constraint: Keep project data and evaluation local.
release.rejected: Public cloud sync of project records was rejected.
release.paraphrase: Place the working records in an internet-hosted shared folder.
release.completed: The schema migration rehearsal is complete.
release.dependency: owner signature on the restore checklist
release.evidence: Rehearsal log E1 verifies schema migration only, not runtime recovery.
release.assumption: The runtime restore will probably work without a rehearsal.
